description: Oilcan 1 on channel 1 loops a 16-step range and Polyperc 1 on channel 2 loops a 12-step range, together for four bars at 90 BPM. Oilcan plays MIDI 36 on steps 1 and 9, MIDI 37 on steps 5 and 13 and MIDI 38 on step 15 at velocity 80; Polyperc plays MIDI 48 on step 1, MIDI 55 on steps 4 and 10 and MIDI 52 on step 7 at velocity 60, so its four notes fall every third step. The two loops start together on step 1, drift apart, and meet again at step 49, after 48 steps, the first count that both 16 and 12 divide into; the bass is then cut off four steps into its next loop when the four bars end. Listen for the bass phrase landing in a different place against the drums in each bar of bars 2 and 3, and for the pair snapping back together at the start of bar 4, about 8 seconds in.
synchronization: Observed framebuffer/grid sampled against host monotonic recording time; not sample-exact or physical-norns calibration.
title: Sixteen steps against twelve
